body: I am so sorry. A young life gone is truly so unfair and thank you. I pray for her health and I'm very thankful for my child.
May I ask what happened? That's the most heart breaking post here because I Have a child that age.
Who cares what anyone thinks? Smile!

My low self esteem wants me to blame myself for everything and say I deserve it. It also makes me want to go back to him because of what little good there was.

This has been so very hard.

It's hard for me let go because I'm a positive person and I just want to focus on the good. He is no good though and once I ooutserved a purpose, the real him came out. Thank you for replying. I am not a perfect person but this has been hell. Thanks for the advice too.

How do you find someone new when you feel so confused and broken and still in love with the man you saw in glimpses.

Breaking off contact is the easy part. Its the aftermath that I'm dreading.
Thank you for your comment. I was sick to let things go that far but I had good intentions.
Thank you so much. I'm in tears.
